definition: A compensation rule explicitly linked to inflation or an index.
analytical_unit: deduplicated municipality × compensation cycle × compensation mechanism × side implementation event
caption: This map shows 31 distinct documented inflation indexing implementation events across 22 municipalities in 8 states. A compensation rule explicitly linked to inflation or an index. The geography matters because it locates the process in the retained evidence. Darker areas contain more events, not more workers or larger wage effects, and the map is not a national prevalence estimate.
